item.title: Tourism growth continues in Chillicothe and Ross County, CVB reports
item.description: CHILLICOTHE, Ohio — Tourism in Chillicothe and Ross County continued to grow in 2025, according to the Ross-Chillicothe Convention & Visitors Bureau. The bureau’s newly released 2025 Annual Report shows lodging tax collections increased 4% over the previous year, a key indicator of overnight visitation. Officials also reported a 6.1% increase in trips originating from […]

item.title: State grants extension as hazardous materials removal continues at former Chillicothe Paper Mill

item.title: Pike County Senior Center to host bake sale and cake auction fundraiser
item.description: WAVERLY, Ohio — The Pike County Senior Center will host a bake sale and cake auction on March 11 to raise money for programs and services that support local seniors. Organizers say proceeds from the fundraiser will benefit congregate and home-delivered meals, wellness activities, social events, and other services provided to seniors throughout Pike County. […]

item.title: Chlamydia leads Pike County’s January infectious disease report
item.description: WAVERLY, Ohio — The Pike County General Health District has released its January 2026 infectious disease report, documenting 15 cases of reportable illnesses last month. According to the report, the most frequently recorded illness was chlamydia, a sexually transmitted infection, with four cases reported in January.
